content: touch-action: manipulation on an element removes the 300ms double-tap delay in Chrome and Safari (supported since Safari 9.3). Setting it on the form, submit button, or links that trigger AJAX actions is the idiomatic modern approach without a JS library. The viewport meta tag width=device-width also largely eliminates the delay on modern browsers. For a Sprockets+jQuery app with no FastClick, applying touch-action: manipulation on interactive form elements is sufficient and has no downside.
